original.target_description: Experiment 1, spatial-orientation test, sex × social/spatial condition interaction in the 2 × 2 between-subjects ANOVA.

n.sample_role: Participants in the final Experiment 1 sex × condition ANOVA; 65 males and 70 females, mutually exclusive final sex groups.
n.exclusions: Four of 139 recruited undergraduates excluded for scoring below chance on the spatial-orientation test.
n.location: p. 1508 (PDF p. 2), Experiment 1 Method—Participants; p. 1511 (PDF p. 5), Results—spatial-orientation ANOVA.
n.quote: Four participants ... were excluded from analyses because they scored below ... chance on the spatial-orientation test. ... 65 males (32 in the social condition and 33 ... in the spatial condition) and 70 females (34 in the social ... condition and 36 in the spatial condition).

es.metric: partial eta-squared (ηp2 as printed in canonical text)
es.location: p. 1511 (PDF p. 5), Experiment 1 Results—spatial-orientation sex × condition interaction.
es.quote: was a statistically significant interaction between sex and ... condition, F(1, 131) = 14.18, p < .001, ηp2 = .10.

notes: Document identity verified from title, authors and DOI 10.1177/0956797616667459 in supplied canonical text. No PDF was supplied. Only assigned unfinished fields examined; other fields/sides are placeholders. Analytic N derivation: 65 + 70 = 135 final participants (equivalently, 32 + 33 + 34 + 36 = 135 across the four sex/condition cells); four below-chance exclusions already removed from these final groups. N is not derived from degrees of freedom. The printed metric is partial eta-squared, not unspecified eta-squared. Interaction p < .001 is printed with this same F, retained in evidence only because p is unassigned.
